Antom Reconciliation Expert 1.0.0 — initial release.

- Supports parsing and full analysis only of local Settlement Detail report files (SETTLEMENT_DETAIL_*.csv / .xlsx).
- Strictly enforces file-format and report-type constraints based on filename and file extension.
- Provides precise, user-friendly error messages and guidance for unsupported files or actions.
- Includes reconciliation knowledge base Q&A focused on settlement amount validation, fee analysis, and reconciliation knowledge topics.
- Handles version check and update prompts before any analysis.
